prior_solution.where: Modern translation sheet bound with the letter (image 0085); not in targets/bouille1778, martinique1778, grassebouille1779 or the catalogue (checked 23 Nov 2026).

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout downloaded the ANOM images (IREL, 23 Nov 2026) and set the rules (protocol hashed before any computation, key frozen by its upstream SHA-256, one measurement); AI agents transcribed, measured and wrote up. No person has checked the transcription.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Both passages (363 groups) and the 11 April postscript (30 groups) transcribed.

Frozen key K8 of targets/grassebouille1779 (SHA-256 6dbabfcd..., unchanged) vs the modern translation: 0.9483 characters vs best of 200 shuffled keys 0.2550 (mean 0.157); criterion >= 0.85 and >= best + 0.30.
Postscript of 11 Apr decoded with K8 (after the measurement): 'L'escadre part après-demain jeudi au nombre de vingt-deux vaisseaux ; j'ai embarqué tro[is ...]'.

outcome.method_basis: Main passages: modern archival translation, confirmed by K8. Postscript: modern archival translation (image 0088); its opening also read with K8 before that sheet was seen, in agreement.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Passages A: translation complete; 206/232 words (88.8%) also supported letter-for-letter by K8. Postscript B: 15 of about 17 words read, sentence cut at the foot of the page.

credits.note: key K8 of targets/grassebouille1779 (validated 28 Oct 2026), frozen before this letter
